• NorthEast United FC vs FC Goa || Highlights || Match 32 || 21-Nov-2026 || English ||
Sixty seconds was all it took! Watch the big moments as FC Goa beat NorthEast United FC 1-0 in Guwahati to end the Highlanders' unbeaten start to the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Muhammed Nemil scored in the opening minute, and Goa spent the rest of the night defending the lead. NorthEast threw everything forward with 22 shots, but goalkeeper Bob Raj stood firm and kept a clean sheet in a feisty game with eight yellow cards.
